geminias:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied ORIGINAL GEMINIAS boss sprite sheet. Preserve this exact character, polished chibi 3D finish, two porcelain robot faces side by side on one body, short blue coat, compact metal boots and cosmic ring crown. DO NOT replace him with a different mascot. Preserve exact 1024x1536 PNG dimensions, 8 columns x12 rows, each 128x128 square, character centers/baselines/frame positions and existing 8-pose animation timing. All sprites fully inside their cells. True transparent alpha background ZERO in gutters, no painted gradient background, no floor.
Requested change A, all normal-form frames: give the character recognisable GEMINI AI brand identity. A large crisp smooth concave FOUR-POINT SPARKLE Gemini logo, gradient cyan-blue-violet-magenta, on chest, not a generic five-point star or gem. Put a small matching fourpoint logo on the forehead of the pale face. Subtle translucent tiny image/video chat tiles near the two shoulders show multimodal intelligence. Preserve original body design, BOTH faces, original blue/ivory armor. Do not add lettering.
Requested change B, phase TWO must be a clearly different EVIL TRANSFORMATION, not recoloring. Same character now a cute creepy corrupted AI villain: both porcelain faceplates visibly crack and pull apart slightly to show deep black digital face interiors; one face has an angry sharp cyan eye, the other a violet slit eye and mischievous pointed digital grin. Two curled black crystal horn/spires grow from the broken crown, coat tips become torn split pointed tails, gauntlet fingers extend into three small shadow claws. Add several sharp floating dark crown shards. Logo on chest remains the clear four-point Gemini emblem but visibly cracked and leaking violet pixels. Purple-black corruption aura tightly around body. Cartoony spooky boss, moderate horror, no gore, no flesh, no realistic teeth, no blood. Keep attractive collectible style, proportions and same overall cell occupancy. Phase 2 must be visibly sinister in silhouette even in grayscale.
Row order MUST REMAIN:
1 normal idle, add logos only.
2 normal hurt, logos only.
3 progressive transformation across 8 frames: start normal, face cracks open, crown horns grow, coat tears, end full corrupted form.
4 corrupted evil idle, subtle breathing and grin.
5 corrupted evil hurt.
6 normal anticipation/charge blue orb.
7 normal attack cyan star.
8 normal blocked attack.
9 CORRUPTED evil anticipation, claw hands charge violet cracked star.
10 CORRUPTED evil attack discharge.
11 CORRUPTED evil blocked/recoil.
12 corrupted evil form defeated and dissolving to purple pixels/stars.
Preserve original poses and effect progression in normal rows 1,2,6,7,8. Corrupted face cracks/horns/claws/torn coat MUST be consistently present in every frame of rows4,5,9,10,11, and first defeat frames in row12. No labels, no frame lines, no words. Fixed camera and scale. Transparent sprite cutouts only.
claudio:

Preserve its beautiful chibi 3D robot sorcerer appearance, ivory porcelain oval mask, burgundy hood and short mantle, copper mechanical armor, open floating book, feather quill, compact boots. Keep camera, scale, exact frame positions, character baseline and 8-pose motion progression. Output exactly 1024x1536 transparent PNG, EIGHT columns xTWELVE rows, all square cells 128x128, safe 8px gutter. No grid lines or labels. Background completely transparent alpha ZERO, not a brown gradient or floor.
CHANGE A NORMAL FORM: strong recognisable CLAUDE AI identity while KEEPING original outfit and body. Add a bold terracotta-orange CLAUDE ASTERISK/SUNBURST LOGO with many uneven rounded radial spokes on the cream chest stole. Repeat the exact terracotta Claude starburst as a seal on the visible book cover and a small mark on mask forehead. Transform normal copper halo into the same irregular many-spoked Claude sunburst silhouette, still copper, not a generic golden sun. Page marks like horizontal document lines and code brackets, no readable words. Cream and warm terracotta accents. Preserve expressive porcelain mask and original book/quill character.

His porcelain mask splits into three large separated floating faceplate pieces around the edges, revealing a solid deep charcoal shadow-face with TWO narrow glowing amber eyes and an exaggerated small jagged luminous orange digital grin. Keep some ivory porcelain visibly framing this black face. Burgundy hood grows TWO curled pointed black/copper horn-like tips, collar rises with three pointed folds. The original Claude-shaped sunburst halo BREAKS into floating sharp angled copper spokes, slightly wider but contained in cell. Open book becomes a sinister sentient book with ONE bright orange eye on its facing cover, pages fluttering like small bat wings. Quill becomes dark angular, hand fingers slightly claw-like. Chest logo remains recognisable TERRACOTTA CLAUDE ASTERISK, now cracked with orange circuit light leaking. Some shadow smoke around shoulders, strictly inside cell. Cute sinister collectible game boss, no blood or flesh, no gore, no realistic horror, no skeleton.
Rows must remain in original exact order:
1 normal idle with Claude logos.
2 normal hurt with logos.
3 eight-step transformation NORMAL to EVIL: mask begins cracking, faceplate sections separate, shadow grin appears, hood horns curl, book eye opens; final frame fully evil.
4 EVIL idle with split mask, shadow grin, hood horns, broken halo and book eye ALWAYS PRESENT.
5 EVIL hurt/recoil then recover, same evil silhouette throughout.
6 NORMAL anticipation warm copper seal charge.
7 NORMAL attack copper Claude asterisk projectile.
8 NORMAL blocked.
9 EVIL charge dark orange asterisk, eye-book open.
10 EVIL attack discharge.
11 EVIL blocked.
12 EVIL defeat, stagger, book eye closes, slumps, shadow and armor dissolve into copper sparks.
Critical: Every single sprite in rows4,5,9,10,11 MUST retain split floating mask framing BLACK SHADOW FACE, amber eyes/orange grin, TWO hood horns and broken halo, including recoil frames. Do not revert to normal face during reactions or attacks. Preserve original normal rows' poses. Distinct evil silhouette, not a palette swap. No text labels. True transparent cutouts, fixed 8x12 grid.
